coverTitle:
One account.
One contact.
Everything connected.
coverSub: A unified service delivery across IT, digital presence, electrical infrastructure, luxury turf, and Google visibility — coordinated under a single accountable relationship. Independent execution partners. One governed account.
introBody: Kopano Lounge recently relocated to Randburg — a new chapter, a new address, and a critical window to own the digital and physical space before competitors do. The Connection Network does not perform the work itself. It coordinates a network of independent, specialist partners — delivered as one account, one monthly relationship, and one person who answers your call.
unitySub: Every division below is scoped, branded, and delivered by its own independent execution partner. The Connection Network governs the relationship — one invoice, one point of contact, one monthly review — without merging any partner's identity into its own.
modulesIntro: Each division is independently delivered by a qualified, separately branded partner — coordinated, invoiced, and reviewed as a single engagement through The Connection Network.

modules.title: IT & Digital Presence
modules.body: Your website currently routes to Instagram — which ranks at zero on Google. CrossTech Systems builds a professional, conversion-focused web presence with full SEO architecture so that anyone searching "lounge Randburg" or "day vibes Blairgowrie" finds Kopano Lounge first.
scope: Custom business website — menu, events, WhatsApp booking, gallery
On-page SEO + schema markup — local search ranking activation
Social content strategy — 4 posts/week brief included

modules.title: Google SEO & GBP Dominance
modules.body: Your Google rating is 4.3 stars across 26 reviews — strong social proof sitting behind incorrect operating hours and no indexable website. InsightForge fixes this within 48 hours and compounds the advantage monthly.
scope: Emergency GBP audit — hours, categories, attributes corrected within 48hr
Keyword mapping — "lounge Randburg," "Blairgowrie nightlife," "day vibes Joburg"
Local citation building — directories, Apple Maps, Bing, Foursquare
Weekly Google Posts schedule + monthly rank tracking report

modules.title: Electrical + USB Client Infrastructure
modules.body: The exposed 4m extension cable running to your counter is a trip hazard, a compliance failure, and a liability. LMGi eliminates it with concealed trunking and adds a modernised USB charging station — turning a safety problem into a client-facing service point.
scope: 3.05m cable trunking — concealed wall run, clips, clean finish
Extension relocation — wall plug to counter, hazard eliminated
2 × under-counter USB charging hubs — client-facing BYOC setup

price.label: Total Estimate (Opt. 01)
price.note: Full upgrade incl. USB hubs · once-off

Distribution box with isolated, labelled outlets for sound + lighting rigs
Surge-protected output for sensitive audio equipment

modules.title: Luxury Turf — Brand Statement
modules.body: Kopano Lounge has an opportunity to use its outdoor or transitional space as a visual brand statement. A premium artificial turf installation from PrimeTurf SA — Gauteng's leading luxury estate grass specialist — signals permanence, care, and quality before a single drink is ordered.
scope: Free site assessment — space measurement and product specification
Estate-grade luxury turf — high-pile, UV-stabilised, pet-safe
Full base preparation, infill, and drainage system
12-year product warranty · zero irrigation · zero maintenance

beforeAfterIntro: Drag the handle to compare current site conditions against the proposed outcome.
